reason: Even the 10-store minimum is almost PHP 960,000 a year, which is more than a year of salary for a merchandising staff member, and nobody can show me it pays back. I'd rather copy what the big chains are already doing with their layouts and test it in a couple of stores myself.
objection: A new company with zero customer results is asking me to lock in 12 months at PHP 8,000 a store when I can't prove a simulated shopper will move my real snack sales enough to cover that.
would_change_my_mind: A paid pilot on 2 or 3 of my stores for 2-3 months with no annual lock-in, where I only continue if the test stores beat the control stores by more than the fee.
